description: Land Title Settlement Department - Thalapyannawa, Kandy Four Gravets and Gangawatakorale D/S Division, Kandy District
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including detailed property descriptions, ownership details, extent measurements, and encumbrances. The content focuses entirely on land registration and property rights, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
